title: Quick Snappy Uruguayan Lemongrass Empanadas
description: A delicious and easy Uruguayan empanada recipe featuring lemongrass, perfect for a quick lunch or dinner.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-high heat.
Cut the fish fillet into small pieces and season with sea salt and black pepper.
Mix the grated lemongrass into the fish pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the flour and eggs.
Gradually add the water to the flour mixture and stir until a dough forms.
Turn the dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and roll each piece into a ball.
Flatten each ball of dough into a disk, then place a tablespoon of the fish and lemongrass mixture in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Grill the empanadas for 4-5 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
Serve the empanadas hot with a side of salsa or chutney, if desired.
